outlets.name: Gault&Millau Deutschland
outlets.credible: Authoritative national dining guide (red toques); institutional authority alongside Michelin. German-language.

outlets.name: GUSTO — Der kulinarische Reiseführer
outlets.credible: Established German fine-dining guide rating restaurants by 'pans'; editorial, professional. German-language.

outlets.name: DER FEINSCHMECKER
outlets.credible: Germany's leading gourmet food magazine; 'Restaurant of the Year' awards carry national weight. German-language.

outlets.name: Restaurant-Ranglisten.de
outlets.credible: German meta-guide consolidating the Michelin/Gault&Millau/Gusto/Varta/Feinschmecker ratings into a single ranking; used only as a corroborating measure alongside a primary guide. German-language.

outlets.name: Saarschleifenland Tourismus (Merzig-Wadern)
outlets.credible: Official destination-marketing authority for the Merzig-Wadern district and the Saarschleife; German-language editorial gastronomy listings.

outlets.name: Merzig SaarSchleifenLand (Kreisstadt Merzig tourism)
outlets.credible: Official tourism portal of the city of Merzig within the Saarschleifenland; German-/English-language.

outlets.name: Mettlach SaarSchleifenLand
outlets.credible: Official tourism portal of the municipality of Mettlach (Saarschleife, Villeroy & Boch); German-/English-language.

outlets.name: Perl SaarSchleifenLand
outlets.credible: Official tourism portal of the wine municipality of Perl (Saar-Obermosel); German-language.

outlets.name: Perl an der Mosel / Saarländischer Weinsommer
outlets.credible: Official Perl wine-culture site and the state Saarländischer Weinsommer programme; authoritative on Perl wineries and Straußwirtschaften. German-language.

outlets.name: Saarland-Lese
outlets.credible: Curated German-language portal on Saarland culture, history, specialities and notable restaurants; editorial, not user-rating.

outlets.name: Wertvolles Neunkirchen (Regionalmarke)
outlets.credible: Official regional-quality brand of the city of Neunkirchen vetting partner producers and gastronomy; German-language.

outlets.name: SR Mediathek / SR Fernsehen ('Im Südwesten kocht die Welt')
outlets.credible: Saarländischer Rundfunk, the ARD public broadcaster for Saarland; its food series profiling immigrant kitchens is authoritative local coverage. German-language.

outlets.name: einkaufen.saarbruecken.de (Stadt Saarbrücken gastronomy portal)
outlets.credible: Official city of Saarbrücken shopping-and-gastronomy portal; German-language editorial listings, not user ratings.

outlets.name: Viezstraße / Route du Cidre
outlets.credible: Official cross-border cider-route (Viez) tourism site for the Saar-Obermosel; German-/French-language, vets member establishments.

outlets.name: LA MAISON hotel & spa Saarlouis
outlets.credible: Official site of the LA MAISON hotel; used only as a factual primary source for its restaurants (LOUIS, PASTIS) alongside the Michelin/Gault&Millau institutional ratings, never as the sole recommender.

outlets.name: Feelgood Magazin
outlets.credible: Saarland/Greater-Region lifestyle magazine reporting on the LOUIS second Michelin star; German-language regional press.
